title: Incredible Tour with María R
text: Our tour guide was María R, and she gave us a heartfelt, in-depth private early access tour to the beautiful and historic Real Alcázar of Seville.   The early access was worth every penny, as you can experience the Alcazar before the crowds and get as many uninterrupted photos as you’d like. María was a great guide, explaining every section and landmark in detail. She provided great historical context, artistic and architectural insight, and a personal touch to the entire experience. title: Amazing Experience!
text:
This tour gives you access to the Alcazar before the general public.  This is a truly unique and phenomenal experience. 
Our tour guide was Raquel was amazing. She has a passion of love for history that is contagious. She truly made us enjoy and understand the remarkable history of this land. Highly recommend this tour.  If you can sign up and try to get Raquel.
author: dolcefarniente_83

title: Knowledgeable guide
text: Raquel was excellent in explaining the history of the Alcazar and of Seville in general.  This tour provided a great opportunity to walk through the palace and grounds before other guests arrived,  which was ideal for photo ops!
